chosen: collective, one electric cylinder feathering from one supercap module (Martin 2026-11-05)

actuator.type: electric cylinder: ball screw lead 5 mm, belt 1:2 to a parallel 48 V PMSM servo, spring-applied holding brake
actuator.screw: ball screw Ø32 x 5, C_dyn >= 30 kN, C_0 >= 60 kN; 20-year travel 1352.0 km at small strokes: L10 by supplier
actuator.current_limit: force limit 21 kN (current), so an end-stop stall cannot overload links, cranks or stops

supercap.module: 21 x 2.7 V / 350 F in series (56.7 V, 16.7 F), active balancing, heater pad (same module as doc 13, one instead of three)

triggers: safety chain opens (STO input + supercap-only mode)
supercap below 2-stroke reserve: feather and stop
fail_safe.sequence: fixed in the drive firmware (certified with the safety system, PL d): drive to 91 deg at 30 deg/s on supercap power, stop on the feather limit switch, set the holding brake
fail_safe.drive_dead: if the drive itself fails, the blades stay where they are; the two spring-applied rotor brakes (8.7 kNm, 12 x rated torque) stop the rotor as the independent second system (doc 11)

links.eye: spherical plain bearings, steel/steel, greased from the hub lubricator (not PTFE: 230 million reversals)
links.tube: Ø30 x 4 S355 with M20 turnbuckle

crank.form: welded S355 tube Ø168 x 8 from the blade-ring flange (clamped by the 10 blade studs) down to the pin plane, lever 25 thick, pin Ø30
crank.storm_note: storm holding: worst case all three blades push the same way, 16.7 kN on the screw, held by the motor brake through the back-driven screw (ball screws are not self-locking)

yoke.form: S355 three-arm plate yoke 20 thick, eyes at R 110, central boss on the cylinder rod, guided by 2 rods Ø25 (also take the yoke torque from the link angles)

hub.material: S355NL (impact tested -50 C), stress relieved after welding, flanges machined after
hub.necks: 3 x tube Ø330 x 10, full-penetration welds, toes ground
hub.neck_flanges: 3 x ring Ø360/Ø262 x 25 (pitch bearing seat, 16 x M16 PCD 300, flatness 0.05 after machining)
hub.rear_flange: ring Ø470/Ø340 x 25: 12 x M16 10.9 PCD 400, Ø361 H7 recess (unchanged interface to the drum)
hub.front_plate: ring Ø460/Ø300 x 12: nose housing flange, 12 x M12 PCD 340

springs.type: nitrogen gas spring (die spring, ISO 11901 type), low-temperature seals
springs.cycles: trips and weekly tests only (about 2,000 in 20 years); the springs do not move in normal pitching

damper.type: hydraulic speed controller (sealed, adjustable), in parallel with the springs
damper.end_buffer: industrial shock absorber on the carriage end stop + rubber blade stops at 93 deg

actuator.type: electric cylinder, ball screw, parallel servo motor with spring-applied holding brake
actuator.motor: 48 V PMSM servo, about 4 Nm peak / 1.3 Nm continuous, 0.4 kW (re-cocking is slow: 10 mm/s)
actuator.C_dyn_needed: ball screw dynamic rating >= 25 kN; screw travel 20 years from pitch duty below

latch.type: roller pawl over a hardened step, toggle ratio >= 25:1, held by a power-on solenoid
latch.release: safety chain opens solenoid power: release < 50 ms; weekly test = real trip at low wind
